acceptance.primary: component identity in ranked positions 1 through 3; category is not part of acceptance
acceptance.secondary: component identity and category in ranked positions 1 through 3
acceptance.canonical_component_identity: strip surrounding whitespace and casefold; no aliases or workbook-derived identity substitutions
acceptance.duplicate_leads: merge equal canonical component identifiers after deterministic score ordering; retain the highest-scoring role and combine distinct evidence records

evidence_combination.family_normalization: Within each eligible family, divide nonnegative diagnostic scores by that family's maximum positive score; family variants share one budget.
evidence_combination.weights: Use runtime.analysis_weights and divide the weighted sum by one common sum of eligible-family weights for every candidate; a candidate absent from a family contributes zero.
evidence_combination.zero_scores: Zero or no-evidence candidates do not create normalized ranks and cannot fill answer slots.

category.prediction_policy: Analysis families (metric, trace error, trace latency, flow, dependency, combined) are not fault categories. Leave category unknown/null unless an evidence-backed fault-category classifier is explicitly implemented; never infer it from evaluator labels.

metric_app.raw_rows: Preserve every input row and expose repeated (serviceName,startTime) counts.
metric_app.duplicate_key_aggregation: median of finite values within each repeated service/time/metric key; each distinct minute is then one support unit
metric_app.window_summary: median across per-minute bucket medians; support is the count of distinct observed minute buckets
metric_app.evidence: Include raw row count, distinct bucket count, repeated bucket count, and selected aggregation.

metric_values.invalid_numeric: Preserve raw text and mark missing/invalid in quality counts; never coerce NaN or infinity into scores.
metric_values.window_aggregation: median within duplicate timestamps, then median across distinct timestamps

contrasts.independent_units: Metric observations are first collapsed to one finite median per distinct source timestamp, then neighboring timestamps are reduced to configured nonoverlapping minute blocks before permutation tests. minimum_support counts distinct timestamps; minimum_independent_blocks counts the resulting blocks.
contrasts.normalized_effect: delta divided by max(reference MAD scaled to normal, abs(reference center) times runtime.relative_scale_floor, runtime.absolute_scale_floor). The two floors are runtime-visible and written in evidence.
contrasts.ranking_strength: abs(normalized_effect) times -log10(max(permutation p, runtime.permutation_p_score_floor)); this is a diagnostic change score, not root-cause probability.

conditional_flow.adaptation: Backend adaptation inspired by MoCE Appendix A.1, not a reproduction of its client expert.
conditional_flow.model: L1 regression of root OSB elapsedTime on same-trace non-root service/container/database elapsedTime features; target is excluded from predictors, fitting uses reference plus alert traces, and collinear features cause abstention.
conditional_flow.eligibility: runtime.flow_min_r2=0.5 and runtime.flow_min_contribution_fraction=0.2 follow the published MoCE values as cautious applicability gates; they are validated on synthetic additive/missing/collinear cases and may cause abstention on Telecom.
conditional_flow.units: Only within elapsedTime values; no conversion to metric_app.avg_time or timestamp differences.

traces.span_identity: (traceId,id); parent pid is resolved only within the same traceId
traces.success: Case-insensitive true/false; absent and unrecognized tokens are missing/invalid, never truthy success.
traces.entity_roles: Keep executing cmdb_id, logical serviceName and database dsName separately.
traces.duration: Preserve elapsedTime and avg_time raw values. Their absolute units are not declared by source; only within-field relative comparisons are permitted until units are established.
traces.clipping: Do not read outside the case reference and alert intervals to repair a missing parent; mark a nonempty parent absent from the clip as unresolved/possibly clipped, not definitely clipped. The source audit found 175 unresolved full-day parent references.

source_gaps: Original E4 implementation was not located; operators and seeds are an explicit reconstruction.
The source query supplies a failure window but no fixed KPI condition; do not claim original KPI-trigger equivalence.
The prior reference window is coverage-eligible, not guaranteed healthy.
Telecom contains backend telemetry, not user/client/session/cohort data.
